12 open-source Whoop projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Whoop bands. 8 of 12 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: OpenStrap Edge, noop, reverse-engineering-whoop-post, atria, totem.
